thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/21/2018: CAMP, ARLO, CRCM, IDTI, MSFT, CSCO, AAPL, IBM, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/21/2018: CAMP, ARLO, CRCM, IDTI, MSFT, CSCO, AAPL, IBM, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.02%
AAPL: +0.59%
IBM: +0.28%
CSCO: +0.96%
GOOG: +50%
Tech stocks were mostly rallying pre-bell Friday.
Moving stocks include:
(-) CalAmp ( CAMP ), which was sinking by more than 8% after the technology company guided for downbeat revenue for its current fiscal quarter.
(+) Arlo Technologies ( ARLO ), which provides smart connected devices and Care.com ( CRCM ), an online marketplace for finding and managing family care, are both set to join the S&P SmallCap 600. CRCM was up more than 8%.
In other sector news:
(+) Integrated Device Technology Inc. ( IDTI ) was up more than 1% after it said in a regulatory filing that it has received clearance from the State Administration for Market Regulation of the People's Republic of China for the planned $6.7 billion purchase of IDT by Japanese chip maker Renesas Electronics Corp.
